page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-24-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance within the c4 family, featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 12 physical Intel Xeon 6985P-C cores running at 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64 and includes a large 504 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 186.0 GB of RAM, providing 7.75 GB of memory per core. The instance also bundles 1343 GB of local NVMe SSD storage across four drives, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses and no GPU hardware.

Performance benchmarks demonstrate top-tier single-threaded capabilities, particularly in data compression and decompression. The instance achieves top-tier status in single-threaded gzip compression at 36.68 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 15.42 GB/sec, alongside a top-tier Geekbench single-core score of 2321.0. Multi-core performance is strong, as shown by a Geekbench multi-core score of 16159.0 and strong image and text processing metrics. For machine learning workloads, the CPU's Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) support high-efficiency execution, yielding top-tier text generation speeds of 394.37 tokens/sec for small 135M LLM models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-24-lssd offers a high-density resource profile by combining substantial memory capacity with fast local NVMe SSD storage. This integrated storage reduces the need for external block storage attachments, optimizing overall infrastructure spend for data-intensive tasks. The hardware configuration is highly suited for memory-intensive workloads, database operations, local caching layers, software compilation, and low-latency text processing or small-scale LLM inference.
